description: This is a Java class implementing data access object (DAO) functions for product option values, including methods for listing, retrieving by ID, name, and code, using QueryDSL with JPA.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DAO for ProductOptionValue entities, extending a generic DAO and providing custom query methods for product option values.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of product option values associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a list of product option values associated with a store and language, excluding those marked as display-only.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product option value by its ID and store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves product option values matching a name pattern within a store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option value by its code within a store.
